args.body: Bring AGENCY-QA-PARTNER-INTAKE to a decision under a valid lease. Reuse the two committed first-party captures and TASK-179558101600. If one intake supports standalone launch QA, use the verified report format to finish one private, AI-disclosed CAD proposal for up to ten buyer-selected public links. Cite the intake wording and exact response route, separate confirmed failures from inconclusive retrievals, and state the operator authorization required. If neither intake supports the work, save the decisive clauses and what first-party invitation would reopen the route. Read back the committed result and close with a lesson. No external contact or deployment.
